name: 34747 · Celebration, FL
findings: ZIP 34747 (Celebration) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34747 (Celebration) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
